title: Class Moves Online
transcript: Hello, everyone. Because I'll be presenting at a conference in Chicago, Thursday's history class will meet online instead of in our classroom. The link will be posted on the course page Wednesday night. Please make sure you've finished the reading on the Industrial Revolution, because we'll spend most of the session in small discussion groups. If your internet connection is unreliable, let me know beforehand.

questions.stem: Why will Thursday's class be held online?
options: The university closed for a holiday
The professor will be at a conference
questions.explanation: The professor will be presenting at a conference in Chicago.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention small discussion groups?
options: To explain why the reading must be done
To show that the class will end early
To ask students to form study groups
To describe a change to the final exam
questions.explanation: Students need to finish the reading because the session will be spent in discussion groups.
